English spelling.

description:

[{'expr': '愛', 'head': 2}, {'expr': 'の', 'head': 2}, {'expr': '字', 'head': -1}]

"愛の字"
# DESCRIPTION ENDS

In previous translations you translated the following words that occur in this
descriptions as follows.

Please be consistent and use the same terminology in this translation.

In addition, please list all content words from the description along with the
translations you gave them. Present these as a list as in the following example:

<VOCABULARY>
<WORD>
<JA>糸輪</JA>  <EN>thread ring</EN>
</WORD>
<WORD>
<JA>五瓜</JA>  <EN>five melon ring</EN>
</WORD>
</VOCABULARY>
